text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that all, I wonder~! I feel like I 
could have set an even more 
earth-shattering time!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El can do it! El's got what it takes! 
World's fastest! But still!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I made it onto the board, too, so that'll 
do for today~

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! I just flapped my wings with 
all my might, yes I did!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Knowing El Condor Pasa and her high 
ideals, there's no end to what she could 
wish for.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A splendid result. And if your body is 
holding up fine...
choice_data_list: El, how are you feeling after the race?
El, are you feeling tired from the race?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
In...? Fatigue...? I'm totally fine death, 
though.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Tough, sturdy, and always full of energy! 
That's because El eats super spicy food!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her footing is solid. With this, it looks 
like we'll be able to grant El Condor 
Pasa's wish.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"‘I won't change my goal. I want to run 
against my rival during the Classic year.’ 
Even if it's only just once, please grant 
that wish."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"So, Trainer-san, where is our next race? 
In the autumn after all?"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Come autumn! Running alongside the Senior 
Class senpais might be...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...Que? Que-que-queee? Did El... hear that 
wrong?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I thought I just heard the word 'Derby'...
choice_data_list: Let's head to the Japan Derby!
Let's go for the Japan Derby!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I tell them once more, with conviction. 
Even knowing it will be quite a grueling 
schedule...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"The Japanese Derby... The Derby...? Right 
after this!?"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
W-What a luxury! I thought we had to pick 
between this and the NHK Mile Cup, but...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Is it really okay for me to enter, 
Trainer!?
choice_data_list: As long as your body is okay, that is
As long as your body is okay, then

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine! If anything, hearing that just 
now made me feel even more energetic!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Bueno! Bueno! Buenobuenobuenooooo!!!!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I can run... In that Nippon Derby...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Together with the ones I love――with 
Spe-chan and the others!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“El Condor Pasa Raids the Derby!” That 
headline spread across Tracen Academy in 
no time.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Grass-chan... did you hear? That news...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I didn't know either. Most likely, 
Trainer-san and El discussed it and 
suddenly...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: El-chan—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BAAAANG!)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: El! I need to talk to you!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ah, Spe-chan!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I, um... had to step in on short notice! 
Um...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
As I thought... would it be better if I 
apologize, yes?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: U-Uuuuuuu...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaaaay!!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Que!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Me too! I wanted to run in the Derby with 
you too, El-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Let's make it an absolutely amazing race! 
Right, El-chan? Together, you and me, 
okay?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Spe-chan...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yeees!!! I'm lookiiing forward to it, 
DEEESU!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A showdown both have long awaited. Then 
there is no reason to shrink back.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want them to test their strength fair 
and square and run a race they can be 
proud of. —At the grandest festival of the 
Classics.
